categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the domestic construction industry in Taiwan, focusing on real estate development including joint construction, land acquisition and self-construction, and related real estate development activities. It also generates rental income from investment properties such as commercial storefronts. The main products are residential buildings and commercial shops, with ongoing projects mainly in southern Taiwan (Tainan, Kaohsiung, Pingtung) and some in northern and central regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced construction technologies including seismic-resistant structures using Japanese vibration control walls and Alfa Safe core columns for enhanced safety. It employs standardized procurement and construction processes, outsourcing construction to qualified contractors while focusing on planning, design, and quality control. The company also integrates green building concepts, energy-saving, and low-pollution construction methods to meet environmental regulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are homebuyers with a focus on first-time buyers and those upgrading homes, targeting the rigid demand segment. The company serves residential buyers in Taiwan's major metropolitan areas, especially in regions with strong employment opportunities and infrastructure development. The market is domestic, with no significant overseas sales or customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with major projects in the southern cities of Tainan, Kaohsiung, and Pingtung, and ongoing or planned developments in northern and central Taiwan including Taipei, New Taipei, and Taoyuan. The company aims to expand its footprint nationwide, including entering the Taichung market in central Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, development planning, design, and sales. Construction work is subcontracted to qualified construction firms, positioning the company as a developer rather than a builder. It also manages sales, marketing, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on rigid demand housing with product designs tailored to modern family needs (2 to 3-bedroom units with dual bathrooms). The company emphasizes quality, safety, and customer service, integrating advanced seismic technologies and green building practices. It plans to diversify into related real estate sectors such as mixed-use commercial buildings and urban renewal projects, while continuously improving operational efficiency and brand value. No formal R&D department exists due to the nature of the construction business.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of residential and commercial real estate units, recognized upon completion and handover of projects. Rental income from investment properties contributes marginally. The company also raises capital through convertible bonds and equity issuance to support development activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The real estate market is highly localized with competition mainly among developers targeting similar geographic and customer segments. The company is recognized as a leading and reputable construction firm in Taiwan, especially in the southern region, with a strong brand and consistent financial performance. Market share is fragmented due to diverse product offerings and localized competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported steady growth with 2024 revenues of approximately NT$4.37 billion, a 17.35% increase over the prior year, and net profit after tax of NT$572 million, up 9.9%. It has maintained four consecutive years of record-high revenues and profits. Total assets are about NT$8.94 billion with equity of NT$1.9 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by a robust land bank and ongoing project completions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-quality construction with advanced seismic safety features, customer-centric design focusing on practical living spaces for first-time and upgrading buyers, and strong after-sales service. It emphasizes sustainable building practices and environmental responsibility. Its brand is well-regarded nationwide, supported by a professional management team and a commitment to delivering projects on schedule, ensuring customer trust and satisfaction.
